items.name: build-your-own-x
items.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
items.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

items.name: yt-dlp
items.summary: yt-dlp 是一款功能强大的命令行音视频下载工具，能够从数千个网站下载媒体内容，解决用户需要离线访问或保存网络视频的实际需求。它通过精心设计的站点提取器架构智能解析不同平台的媒体流，支持自动合并视频与音频轨道，并可应用后处理滤镜优化输出质量。用户只需简单命令即可下载指定画质的视频、提取纯音频文件，或将其集成到自动化脚本中批量处理教学资料、技术讲座等有价值内容，非常适合媒体收藏和内容分析场景。
items.summary_en: yt-dlp is a powerful command-line tool that solves the practical problem of downloading videos and audio from thousands of websites when you need offline access or want to archive content. It works by intelligently extracting media streams through extensive site-specific extractors and can merge multiple formats while supporting post-processing filters. You can use it via simple commands to download specific quality formats, extract audio only, or integrate it into scripts for batch processing your favorite educational or entertainment content.

items.name: odoo
items.summary: Odoo是一套开源ERP与商业应用套件，通过单一平台统一管理销售、库存、财务、人力资源等核心业务流程。其模块化架构允许用户仅安装所需应用（如CRM、电商、会计），按需扩展，避免系统臃肿。技术层面，Odoo采用Python开发，支持前后端高度定制，内置强大工作流引擎和报表工具。部署方式灵活，可本地运行或使用云服务。对中小企业而言，Odoo提供低成本、渐进式实施的数字化管理方案，是替代昂贵商业ERP的理想选择。
items.summary_en: Odoo is an open-source ERP and business application suite that helps companies manage sales, inventory, accounting, HR, and more from a single platform. Its modular architecture lets you start with one app and add others as needed, avoiding the bloat of traditional ERP systems. You can deploy it on-premise or in the cloud, customize modules via Python, and integrate with third-party tools through its API. Ideal for SMEs seeking an affordable, scalable business management solution.

items.name: nn-zero-to-hero
items.summary: nn-zero-to-hero 是 Andrej Karpathy 推出的神经网络实战课程，以 Jupyter Notebook 为载体，通过 Python 代码逐步实现反向传播、神经网络和 Transformer 等核心概念。课程强调数学直觉与代码实现紧密结合，帮助学习者深入理解模型底层原理。内容从线性模型到完整语言模型循序渐进，每环节配有可运行代码示例，适合希望扎实掌握深度学习基础的研究者或工程师。
items.summary_en: nn-zero-to-hero is a hands-on course by Andrej Karpathy that teaches neural networks from scratch using Python and Jupyter notebooks. It demystifies deep learning by building backpropagation, neural networks, and transformers step by step, emphasizing mathematical intuition and code implementation. Ideal for learners who want to truly understand how models work under the hood, the course provides practical exercises to build and train your own networks, making advanced concepts accessible.

items.name: cfnew
items.summary: cfnew是一个轻量级框架，旨在用最少的代码构建和部署自定义AI模型。它采用模块化架构，将模型定义、训练和推理分离，支持快速原型开发。核心设计理念是通过配置文件定义模型结构，大幅减少样板代码。你可以用它快速尝试不同的神经网络设计，或通过单条命令将模型部署到生产环境。适合需要快速迭代实验的AI开发者，尤其适合从研究到落地的过渡阶段。
items.summary_en: cfnew is a lightweight framework for building and deploying custom AI models with minimal code. It leverages a modular architecture that separates model definition, training, and inference, enabling rapid prototyping. The key insight is its use of configuration files to define model architectures, reducing boilerplate. You can use it to quickly experiment with different neural network designs or deploy models to production with a single command.

items.name: electra-small-discriminator
items.summary: ELECTRA-Small-Discriminator 是一种轻量级预训练语言模型，通过检测文本中被替换的标记来学习，相比掩码语言建模，训练效率更高。其核心技术是生成器-判别器架构：小型生成器替换部分标记，判别器则判断每个标记是否被替换，从而在参数量较少的情况下获得强大性能。你可以使用 Hugging Face Transformers 对其进行微调，应用于文本分类、序列标注等下游任务，或作为资源受限场景下的轻量特征提取器。该模型特别适合需要快速部署且计算资源有限的实际应用。
items.summary_en: ELECTRA-Small-Discriminator is a compact pretrained language model that learns to detect replaced tokens in text, making training more sample-efficient than masked language modeling. Its key innovation is a generator-discriminator setup where the discriminator identifies tokens replaced by a small generator, enabling strong performance with fewer parameters. Use it for downstream tasks like text classification or sequence labeling by fine-tuning with Hugging Face Transformers, or as a lightweight feature extractor for resource-constrained applications.

items.name: bert-base-uncased
items.summary: BERT-base-uncased是一种双向语言理解模型，通过同时分析上下文捕捉完整语义，克服了传统单向模型的局限。其核心技术为掩码语言建模，训练时随机遮盖词汇并预测内容，从而学习深层语言规律。该模型可通过Hugging Face库加载，支持微调实现文本分类或问答功能，也可直接提取词向量用于语义相似度计算，为自然语言处理提供基础能力。

items.name: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2
items.summary: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2是基于BERT的轻量级文本排序模型，专为语义搜索和信息检索优化。通过知识蒸馏技术压缩大型模型的语义理解能力，在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算成本。该模型可应用于智能搜索、文档检索和内容推荐系统，通过编码文本对并计算相似度实现精准语义匹配，尤其适合高效处理海量文本数据的场景。
items.summary_en: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2 is a compact BERT-based model optimized for text ranking and semantic search tasks, solving the challenge of efficient information retrieval from large text collections. It employs knowledge distillation to compress a larger teacher model into a smaller arc…

items.name: electra-base-discriminator
items.summary: ELECTRA-base-discriminator是一种基于判别式预训练的Transformer模型，通过将掩码语言建模改为区分真实与生成器产生的替代标记，显著提升训练效率。其核心创新是使用小型生成器产生替代标记，再由判别器识别真假，比BERT等模型训练更快且性能强劲。开发者可通过Hugging Face库微调该模型，应用于文本分类、命名实体识别或问答任务，特别适合计算资源有限但需要高质量语言理解的场景。
